== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Generic pilot and astromech capacity becomes Luke and A New Hope R2-D2. The once-per-game limit on pulling one astromech disappears from the printed clause. Attrition immunity and starfighter text cancellation no longer require Luke already piloting. The cancellation is expressed during battle with a here requirement and loses explicit remainder-of-turn duration. Protected attributes and printed ratings agree.
